title: Late Fees Standing and the Months of a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Hardship Deferral
content:
*Collections risk note, Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing.*

**Rule.** On an account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan), late fees standing from the six months before the grant, counting late-fee entries less late-fee reversals, adjust the months of a hardship deferral: three or more take two months away; exactly two take a month away; fewer leave the months alone. The adjustment is added to the months asked on the request, and the months granted are never more than the months asked nor below zero.

## The count

The late-fee entries posted on the financing account in the six months before the day the deferral is granted, less the late-fee reversals posted in those same six months.

| Late fees standing (six months) | Adjustment to the months |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | Less 2 months |
| Exactly 2 | Less 1 month |
| 1, none, or fewer | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical histories)

- Three late-fee entries in the six months, none reversed: 3 standing, less 2 months.
- Three late-fee entries in the six months, one reversed in that window: 2 standing, less 1 month.
- Two late-fee entries in the six months, both reversed: 0 standing, no adjustment.
- A late-fee entry posted seven months before the grant is outside the six months and is not counted.

## Hypothetical outcome

A request asks for 2 months and 3 late fees stand from the six months before the grant: 2 less 2 leaves 0 months under this rule, never below zero.
